title: MQL-0009 - NL->MQL retrieval-control experiment (zero-shot / random / fixed / hybrid RAG)
status: PACKAGE BUILT - NOT EXECUTED (no prediction or score exists)
question: Does the MQL-0008 hybrid-RAG gain come from RELEVANT retrieval, or from supplying any three demonstrations?

model.label: qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct
model.dtype_note: bfloat16 exactly as MQL-0006/0007/0008. Those runs used a Tesla T4 (compute capability 7.5), which has no native bf16: PyTorch emulated bf16 (torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() is True with emulation). The notebook records compute capability and bf16_native per run, accepts only the registered GPU, and never substitutes fp16/fp32.
model.oom_policy: a batch that hits CUDA OOM is retried one prompt at a time (same prompt/dtype/decoding) and the record says so

hardware.resolution: keep bf16 (comparability with MQL-0008 arm B); T4 bf16 is emulated, recorded as such; all 8 runs must share GPU type, dtype, torch and transformers (resume refuses otherwise)

prompt.rag_rule: RAG prompt = zero-shot prompt with one reference block inserted before the final 'Question:' line; empty context => byte-identical to zero-shot
prompt.schema_context: nl-mql-spider1-v1 Atlas-form context for the 16 held-out DBs, derived offline from SQLite with the import_atlas.py mapping (provisioning contract: scoring requires full Atlas parity)

evaluation.source: spider-pool-v3 val_internal membership (639) x spider-sql-v1 val_internal records; database-level split of Spider train (16 whole DBs, seeded shuffle seed 20261027); gold SQL / rows NOT shipped
evaluation.protected_note: the 892-item MQL-0008 evaluation set (Spider dev) and the 65-item test partition are not used

corpus.name: approved_corpus_v2_1

eligible_view.rule: corpus rows whose db_id is not an evaluation database (and not otherwise excluded), corpus order

corpus.review_label: AI-reviewed (G-AIR, AI-only protocol); never human-reviewed. Labels validated on local MongoDB 8.0.34 with verifier 3.1; never executed on Atlas.

retrieval.index: per target database, target-db documents excluded
retrieval.dedup: same doc_id, same MQL, or same normalised question: higher-ranked copy kept

context.token_budgeting: Qwen2.5 tokenizer at the pinned revision (HF AutoTokenizer, add_special_tokens=False) over system+user text and the block; over-budget documents are skipped (dropped_budget), never truncated

B_random_s1.label: B. random RAG seed 1: retrieval.Retriever(method='random', seed=20261181)

B_random_s2.label: B. random RAG seed 2: retrieval.Retriever(method='random', seed=20261182)

B_random_s3.label: B. random RAG seed 3: retrieval.Retriever(method='random', seed=20261183)

B_random_s4.label: B. random RAG seed 4: retrieval.Retriever(method='random', seed=20261184)

B_random_s5.label: B. random RAG seed 5: retrieval.Retriever(method='random', seed=20261185)

C_fixed.label: C. fixed-example RAG: the same 3 frozen corpus ids for every question

D_hybrid.label: D. MQL-0008 hybrid RAG (hybrid_masked, w=1.0), unchanged

random_retrieval.method: retrieval.Retriever(method='random'): per question, order = random.Random(int(sha256(f'{seed}:{qid}:{question}')[:16], 16)).shuffle(corpus order); target-db, duplicate and exclusion filtering, then the shared budget loop takes the first 3 that fit (uniform over the eligible view, distinct)

fixed_retrieval.procedure: seeded draw from the eligible view; corpus attributes + question-level leakage gate only; see preflight/fixed_selection.json

leakage_gates.policy: L1 db / L2 id+source overlap: STOP; L3 exact, L4 normalised question, L5 Jaccard >= 0.8: evaluation-specific retrieval exclusion after ranking, identical for every demonstration arm; L6/L7 SQL-based: report only (gold never drives retrieval)

session_plan.estimate_basis: MQL-0008 Tesla T4 wall clock: zero-shot 2.3 h / 892 items, hybrid 12,198.8 s / 892 items
session_plan.rule: sessions 2 and 3 resume from the previous version's output (RESUME_FROM='auto') in the pinned environment; a 12-hour Kaggle session cannot hold all runs. Session 1 holds D and one random seed together so the primary contrast has a same-session pair. If the pinned environment is lost (resume refused), regenerate ALL runs in one new environment under a new output; never mix environments

stated_differences_from_MQL-0008: evaluation set: 639 held-out Spider-train questions on 16 databases (spider-sql-v1 val_internal / spider-pool-v3) instead of the 892 Spider-dev questions; schema context derived offline (those DBs are not on Atlas yet)
arms: A, five random seeds, fixed, hybrid (8 runs) instead of A and hybrid
retrieval exclusions recomputed for this evaluation set (question-level gates); the MQL-0008 exclusions refer to dev ids
prediction records add prediction_id, arm_family, random_seed, precision, runtime, parse_status, normalized_mql
the eligible corpus view equals the full approved corpus (no corpus database is an evaluation database)
